title: knowledge(testing): license-entitlement failures on posted tables in a SaaS test run are environmental
summary: A testing knowledge article explains how to triage and fix license-entitlement failures on posted tables in SaaS test runs, distinguishing them from permission regressions and recommending data production through posting APIs.
key_points: Adds a testing knowledge article: license-entitlement failures from direct inserts into posted tables in SaaS test runs are environmental
TestPermissions = Disabled and SUPER do not lift the license check
Triage by comparing with the baseline in the same environment; fix by producing posted data through test library posting codeunits
Includes good and bad AL samples and updates the al-testing-review skill
Adds scripts for detecting changed review paths and updates the review-fixtures workflow and evaluation tooling
